# Field Journal

Running log for the season. Entries are dated headings; the recurring
subheadings under each entry are slots.

## 2026-06-01

Opened the north valve at dawn and walked the manifold line.

#### Reflection

The manifold held pressure, so the valve rebuild was worth doing. Manifold
work is slow but the valve seats are sound now.

#### Metrics

flow_rate: 4.2
soil_moisture: 31

## 2026-06-08

Second valve pass. The manifold leaked at the third union until I reseated it.

### Reflection

Dana walked the manifold with me and found the union I missed. Valve tuning
is mostly patience.

### Synthesis

Agent summary: manifold reliability dominates every other valve concern in
this window, and the manifold union pattern repeats.

## 2026-06-15

Season review with Dana Okonjo. Drip irrigation beat the sprinkler comparison
on every zone. Drip won on coverage and on water use.

### Reflection

Confidence in drip irrigation is high now. The sprinkler option is closed.

## 2026-07-06

Laid mulch across the south beds. Mulch depth matters more than I expected.

### Reflection

Mulch held moisture through the heat. Straw mulch beat bark mulch on the
south beds.

## 2026-07-13

Harvest began. First harvest of tomato and basil, and the mulch kept the
harvest window open longer.

### Reflection

Harvest timing followed the mulch line exactly.

### Metrics

flow_rate: 3.8
soil_moisture: 44

## 2026-07-20

Harvest continued through the week. Mulch top-up on the north beds before the
next harvest pass.
